text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but my early sales meant I was less invested when the account later rose; I should base sales on my plan, not the pleasure of locking in a gain.","I bought several stocks again after selling earlier, so I should pause before trading and consider whether a change in my reasons—not just a price move—justifies the transaction.","My account grew while I made no trades in periods 4–6 and 8–10; since past price moves do not predict future ones, I should be patient and avoid trading just because I check prices often."]}
